verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical: both enlarge the backdrop circle and pull it in from the edge, so it reads as a large blob crowding the lower right. Both leave a big empty band above the quote mark while the bottom half is crowded. A's attribution sits tight under the quote and its can floats high, away from the bottom edge where the original anchored it. B keeps the original's gap under the quote and sits the can lower, so it is slightly more faithful, but its logo still floats with no clear alignment to the can.
